d: Bihar MLC Election Result 2026 : bihar ki siyasat men MLC chunav ke natijon ke bad jediyu men manthan shuru ho gaya hai. patna sthit parti karyalay men chunavi har ki samiksha ko lekar aham baithak bulaee gaee hai. jediyu ne 4 siton par chunav lara tha, lekin parti ko mahaj ek sit par hi jit mili. aise men chunavi natijon, har ke karnon aur sangthan se jure dusre muddon par bhi charcha hone ki sanbhavna hai. baithak ko lekar bihar ki rajnitik galiyaron men halchal tej hai. aakhir chunavi har ke bad jediyu ki ranniti kya hogi?
